text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer is here, along with the<n>opportunity for
significant growth.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder appears unbothered<n>by the looming
Japan Cup, but I know<n>she's burning with
determination.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We'll put that fervor to use and make<n>the most of
the summer camp!
